items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I was pretty much playing all of Louis's numbers

ctx.x: What did you record? What tunes? Do you remember?

Well, Mahogany Hall Stump, and I know for sure that Mahogany Hall Stump in China Time, all that kind of numbers. I was pretty much playing all of Louis's numbers, he put it out, when you're smiling and so

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: See, well he came over at the hall and I got to know him. Which is a fine, fine man and a crazy buddy kid.

ctx.x: And that's the first time that I remember Lewis because when Lewis was here I didn't know him. See, well he came over at the hall and I got to know him. Which is a fine, fine man and a crazy buddy kid.
